candidate_relations.reason: Pheochromocytoma specifically denotes an adrenal medullary tumor. Applying the pheochromocytoma label conflicts with the established anatomy.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pheochromocytoma implies adrenal origin; CT shows normal adrenal glands and a bladder mass

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Phaeochromocytoma of the bladder is a recognized but distinct entity from paraganglioma of the bladder; also omits metastatic status
